Petya will find the search field, enter the name, and read the available results right from the window, without the Telegram API. Commands are also available by voice (in Russian): «введи текст …» (type text …), «нажми ввод» (press Enter), «нажми сохранить» (press Save), «клик 500 300» (click 500 300), «останови управление» (stop control). New commands: «нажми Ctrl+Shift+S» (press Ctrl+Shift+S; on Mac, Cmd+Shift+S), «прокрути вниз 5» (scroll down 5), «двойной клик 500 300» (double-click 500 300), «правый клик 500 300» (right-click 500 300), «перетащи 100 200 в 400 500» (drag 100 200 to 400 500), «переключись на приложение Safari» (switch to the Safari app). Also: cut, undo, redo, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Delete. Coordinates are measured from the top-left corner of the main screen. Emergency stop: Ctrl+Shift+F12 (⌘+Shift+F12 on Mac). While actions run, a teal “Petya” cursor and a badge on the controlled window are visible. They let clicks pass through and disappear when done.
